name: deckwerk
description: Cross-platform WYSIWYG slide editor with first-class video support
author: Vincent Sitzmann <sitzmann@mit.edu>

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && electron-vite build && npm run build:export && npm run build:collab
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:importer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:importer && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.test:ordinary: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.export: npm run build:export >/dev/null && vite-node --config vitest.config.ts scripts/export-deck.mts --
scripts.build:collab: vite build --config vite.collab.config.ts && vite build --config vite.bridge.config.ts
scripts.eval:agent: npm run build:collab && vite-node --config vitest.config.ts scripts/eval-agent.mts
scripts.eval:agent:serve: npm run build:collab && vite-node --config vitest.config.ts scripts/serve-agent-benchmark.mts
scripts.eval:papers:serve: npm run build:collab && vite-node --config vitest.config.ts scripts/serve-paper-benchmark.mts
scripts.eval:edits:serve: npm run build:collab && vite-node --config vitest.config.ts scripts/serve-edit-benchmark.mts
scripts.eval:importer: npm run build:export && vite-node --config vitest.config.ts scripts/eval-importer-regressions.mts
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:importer && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:importer && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
